articles.title: OCC calls on community banks to enter the stablecoin payments market
articles.snippet: The U.S. banking regulator is encouraging smaller lenders to develop stablecoin services as new federal licensing requirements approach.

articles.title: Canada opens consultation on draft stablecoin rules, maintains ban on yields
articles.snippet: Under the draft rules, non-bank stablecoin issuers must back tokens 1:1 with reserves held at qualified Canadian institutions and settle redemptions within three business days.

articles.title: AI giant Anthropic files for blockbuster IPO
articles.snippet: The maker of Claude reported $16.3 billion in first-half revenue and an $80.7 billion net loss as it aims to price its offering in mid-November.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin dips below $80,000 as stocks rally following Anthropic IPO filing
articles.snippet: Alongside Anthropic raising as much as $100 billion, Meta on Monday announced a $95 billion share sale to fund its own AI ambitions.

articles.title: Bitcoin wallet bug let rogue servers steal funds when users tried to speed up payments
articles.snippet: Attackers replaced legitimate transactions with fake ones, then waited for users to approve higher fees. At least one person lost bitcoin before developers patched the flaw.
